content: Bhela itupalika kughakamulaki nakanopi mambu ghala ghatujomwi kughajowana, nahuli ngatwihika kughakosa.
Ubholu ghola ghobhakapekiwi bhazee bhitu na bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga ukabhonakini kubha chakaka, na mundu jokapi ambaju ngacheakaujengalili au kuutii akalapuliki ngati moikampalakile.

Bhela, bho, tepani anatukengaliwa bholi anangati ngachetujali ukengalelu ukolongwa ntundu aghogho? Kutumbula Bambo mweni akautangizi ukengaleku ghoni, na bhandu bhala bhabhakaujowini bhakaulangihi kwitu kubha nde wa chakaka.
Chapanga najombi akaulandili papamu na bhandu bhala bhabhakaulangi kwitu kwa kuhenga kila ntundu wa nginyulila na ngangachu yamaheli, na kubhaghabhila Roho Mhuhu ngati moakapali mweni.
Chapanga ngacheakabhabhekiki bhatumika bhaki bha kunani kumahunde bhautawalaje ndema ghouhika, yani ndema ghola ghotulongalela malobhi ghaki.
Kabhete kubhi na pandu pangi pa Malembu Mahuhu papwagha ana:

content.text: “Bho, mundu nde chindu bholi hata unkomboka,
au mwana waka mundu, hata undingalila?
Untendiki kubha pahi pachokopi kupeta bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga,
unhwatiki litaji la ulumbalilu na utopelu, na umbekiki ajemalyaje panani ja mahengu gha mabhoku ghaku.
Ubhekiki hindu yokapi pahi ja magholu ghaki.”

content: Kwa ndandi kwa kubheka hindu yokapi pahi jaki, Chapanga ngacheakachilekiki chindu chokapi chela ambachu ngacheakachibhekiki pahi ja utawala waki. Nambu kwa sajenu tukali ngakubhona kubha hindu yokapi itawaliwa naku.

Nambu tumbona Yesu, joakatendakiki kubha pahi pachokopi kupeta bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga kwa chikahi chijipe, nahuli kwa chihomu chaka Chapanga apata kupotela kwa ndandi ja bhandu bhokapi. Sajenu tumbona akabya awatikwi litaji la ulumbalilu na utopelu kwa ndandi akahinakili kupotela.

Kwa ndandi ikampaliki Chapanga, ambaju kwa ndandi jaki na kwa indela jaki hindu yokapi abhombiki na kuikamulakila, kubhaleta bhana bhamaheli bhauholalya ulumbalilu, na kunkamilisha Yesu chiongozi wabhu nkolongwa wa ukengaleku kwa indela ja mang'ahiku.
Jombi abhagholola bhandu mahoku ghabhu, najombi papamu na bhala bhabhagholuleka, bhokapi bhabhili na Atati jumu. Nde ndandi Yesu ngacheabhona iyoni kubhaloha bhanihabha bhalongu bhaki.

content.text: na pachilanda ja likanisa ananukujembila nyembu ya kukulumbalila.”

content: Kabhete apwagha: “Anamekaje lihobhalelu langu muka Chapanga.” Na kabhete apwagha: “Lingalya, nepani mi pambani papamu na bhana bhaambekihe Chapanga.”

Bhela kwa kubha bhana bhanihabha nde bhandu bhabhabhi na hyegha na mwahi, Yesu mweni akabhi ngati bhombi na kushiliki mu ghanihagha. Akahengiki bhenibhela nahuli kwa indela ja kupotela kwaki, ahekataje makili ghaka Shetani, joabhi na makili panani ja kupotela,
na kubhabheka kulijeka bhandu bhala bhokapi bhabhakabhili bhatumwa kwa matamu ghabhu ghokapi kwa ndandi ja kujoghopa kupotela.
Kwa ndandi nde chakaka, kubha jombi ngacheakahikiki kubhajangati bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga, nambu akahikiki kubhajangatila lubheleku lwaka Ibulahimu.

Kwa ndandi jeniheji ikampaliki kulengana na bhalongu bhaki kwa ntundu wokapi, nahuli apata kubha Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa joabhi na chiha na ndongwana mu kuntumakila Chapanga, nahuli awezaje kutenda ujonganeshu kwa ndandi ja mahoku gha bhandu.
Na kwa ndandi mweni akang'ahakiki paakalengakike, henu aweza kubhajangatila bhandu bhala bhabhalengakeka.
